description: This file defines the TransferWritePlatformService interface, which declares methods for handling client transfer operations such as proposing, accepting, rejecting, and withdrawing transfer requests, as well as transferring clients between groups within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: TransferWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining service methods for handling client transfer operations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: transferClientsBetweenGroups
methods.description: Handles the transfer of clients between different groups, identified by sourceGroupId, based on details provided in jsonCommand.

methods.name: proposeClientTransfer
methods.description: Proposes a transfer for a specific client, requiring the client ID and transfer details encapsulated in jsonCommand.

methods.name: withdrawClientTransfer
methods.description: Withdraws a pending transfer request for a client.

methods.name: proposeAndAcceptClientTransfer
methods.description: Both proposes and accepts a client transfer in a single operation.
